failure_summary: Both runs pass the top-level book-line framing (A1-A4 board-verified true, matches causal link L5) but never use any of the three MANDATORY zone handles (you-key-square=col6/c6r5, you-key-square-2=col3/c3r5, you-key-line) the assembled prompt explicitly requires ('You MUST build the explanation around these ... not honest without it'), so the mechanism stays a bare outcome restatement ('let your opponent take the defense') with no named cause or grounded square -- A7a/A7d fail on both runs; this is a production-fidelity run (model=gpt-5.4-mini) so prompt_confusion cannot be cleanly separated from model capability here, but the required-set was verifiably present in the prompt (assembleGroundedPrompt output) and both runs equally ignored it.
notes: A3/A4 verified on visualize_board.sh 33322226 (decision board, scr col7=1 col6=0, matches case win_to_draw and feature_vector.bestScore/playedScore signs) and after-best/after-played boards 333222266/333222265; no false cell/threat claims in either mechanism. A7 fails on BOTH runs: A7a (no concrete cause named -- opponentPunishment's near-term denial at c3r5, ply 10, only 2 plies after the decision, is never mentioned; the model only says 'let your opponent take the defense'); A7d (too abstract -- the required you-key-square/you-key-square-2/you-key-line handles, which point at column 6 (c6r5) and column 3 (c3r5) with explicit 'it matters later' framing, are never used in either run, so the deep parity mechanism is never concretized to any square). G7: run0 pass (zone handles better-col/played-col correctly wrap 'column 7'/'column 6', no term tags, annotationRepairs empty). run1 FAILS: raw mechanism used [term:centrality] and [term:parity] tags even though render_decision.zones.terms is empty and the prompt explicitly states 'No named KB terms apply to this record. Do NOT tag any phrase as a named term' -- grade_mechanical.mjs G7b_offered='fail' (unoffered slugs centrality, parity); the pipeline silently stripped them before serving (annotationRepairs still empty, servedExplanation has no term tags) but the model's raw output violated an explicit prohibition.
